summary: Trình IDE nhẹ nhàng tích hợp AI Pi để hỗ trợ viết code theo phong cách vibe-coding, tùy chỉnh tự động theo cách làm việc của người dùng.
usecases: Quick code writing with AI agent Pi support in IDE.
Automatic spec-driven code development from natural language requests.
Personalized workflow customization for programming task automation.
ideas: Integration with project management platforms to generate code from natural language requests.
Development of plugins for other IDEs based on the same spec-driven principle.
Use in programming education to generate code samples in the user's style.
